Anyone who is delighted by this will not be wise.

so also is the dread of a king.

Whoever provokes him sins in his own soul.
Honor est homini qui separat se a contentionibus;
Honor is for the man who separates himself from contentions.
But all the foolish meddle in altercations.
Because of the cold, the lazy one was not willing to plough.
Therefore, in the summer, he will beg,
and it will not be given to him.
Sicut aqua profunda, sic consilium in corde viri;
Counsel in the heart of a man is like deep waters.
But a wise man will draw it out.
But who will find a faithful man?
Justus qui ambulat in simplicitate sua beatos post se filios derelinquet.
The just who walks in his simplicity shall leave behind him blessed sons.
Rex qui sedet in solio judicii dissipat omne malum intuitu suo.
The king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters all evil with his gaze.

Take away the vestments of him who stands up to vouch for a stranger,
et pro extraneis aufer pignus ab eo.
and take a pledge from him instead of from outsiders.

Do not become involved with him who reveals mysteries,
Qui maledicit patri suo et matri,
Whoever curses his father and mother,
extinguetur lucerna ejus in mediis tenebris:
his lamp will be extinguished in the midst of darkness.

When an inheritance is obtained hastily in the beginning,
in the end it will be without a blessing.
Abominatio est apud Dominum pondus et pondus;
Diverse weights are an abomination with the Lord.
A deceitful balance is not good.
The steps of men are directed by the Lord.
quis autem hominum intelligere potest viam suam?
But who is the man able to understand his own way?
It is ruin for a man to devour what is holy, or,
after making vows, to retract them.
A wise king scatters the impious
and bends an archway over them.
The spirit of a man is a lamp to the Lord,
which investigates all the secrets of the inner self.
Mercy and truth guard the king,
and his throne is strengthened by clemency.
The joy of youths is their strength.
And the dignity of old men is their grey hairs.
The bruise of a wound, as well as scourges,
shall wipe away evils in the more secret places of the inner self.
